title: Cognix Workflow Spec
description: Schema for a Cognix workflow YAML spec file (see FORMAT.md). Matches the deserialization rules of the Rust Workflow struct.

name.description: The name of the Workflow. Required.

command.description: The command executed when the Workflow is selected. Required. Use {{argument_name}} for parameterized arguments.

tags.description: Tags used to categorize the Workflow. Optional.

description.description: Description of what the Workflow does. Optional (null/omitted means no description).

arguments.description: Parameterized arguments referenced as {{name}} in the command. Optional.

name.description: Argument name, must match the {{name}} placeholder in the command.

description.description: Description surfaced in Cognix/commands.dev to help users fill in the argument.

default_value.description: Default value for the argument. YAML `~` (null) means no default.

source_url.description: URL where the Workflow was originally generated from. Optional.

author.description: Original author of the Workflow. Optional.

author_url.description: URL of the original author. Optional.

shells.description: Valid shells (zsh, bash, fish; case-insensitive). Empty means all shells. Optional.
